contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Acne Scars Removal in Ghaziabad & Noida

Permanent reduction of Acne Scars — for all skin tones.

Acne scars deteriorate an individual's appearance but there are advanced technologies tailored for effective treatment. Acne scars affect texture and confidence in an individual. This condition is prevalent and people are battling against uneven skin, marks, and deep scars to achieve flawless skin. Choosing professional scar treatment is the best step towards achieving refined, restored, and radiant skin.

ACNE SCARS

What Are Acne Scars?

  • Formation of inflamed blemishes
  • Deep skin layer damage
  • Production of less or more collagen

Based on the severity and type of acne scar, treatment is recommended by a qualified specialist.

UNDERSTANDING SCARS

Types of Acne Scars

Each scar on the skin is caused while attempting to heal a skin flaw

01

Atrophic Scars

These deep-pitted marks formed due to skin issues such as scars, trauma, chickenpox or loss of tissue. These come up on the face like rolling scars.

  • Pits are narrow and deep
  • Contains sharp edges
  • Collagen boost required to transform it into healthy skin
  • Unstable wave sort of structures
02

Keloid Scars

Yet another scar rooted in the skin due to extra collagen production. These are thick, have an itchy growth - after witnessing specific injuries such as piercings, surgery, or acne. By nature, these scars are raised and mostly found on the shoulders, chest, or earlobes.

  • Causes tenderness and pain
  • Looks pink or dark brown in color
  • Originates while skin is healing from trauma
  • Prominent in individuals genetically at a risk who are between 10-30 years and have dark skin tones
03

Reactive Hyperpigmentation

This is medically even referred to as Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation. It forms when the skin produces excessive melanin while healing. These are dark spots or patches that are left back on the skin post-inflammation or injury. With the help of a specific approach improvement is possible.

PROFESSIONAL CARE

Relevance of Professional Acne Scar Treatment

Home remedies and over-the-counter creams help address slight pigmentation. Professional treatment is required for taking care of specific concerns such as:

01

Boosting collagen production

02

Smoothening skin texture

03

Decreasing pigmentation

04

Reducing evident pits

05

Boosting skin clarity

Intervening at the right time helps with reducing visibility of scar texture.

ADVANCED TREATMENTS

Advanced Acne Scar Treatments We Offer

01

Laser Resurfacing

Laser treatment is one of the best solutions for acne scars. It treats the skin by getting rid of layers that are damaged and require a collagen boost. It refines moderate and deep scars. Works on enhancing texture and the skin tone. Effectively decreases pigmentation and offers long-term results. For targeted treatment, fractional lasers are best as they provide less downtime.

02

Microneedling

Microneedling is also referred to as collagen induction therapy. Tiny injuries are formed on the skin with the help of needles to improve collagen production. Helps with treating enlarged pores and moderate scars. Suitable on many skin types. It is known for boosting the texture of the skin.

03

RF Microneedling

Using heat and a blended approach of radiofrequency and microneedling, collagen remodeling is addressed. It tends to deeply penetrate into the skin, offers excellent elasticity, works best on stubborn scars, and is friendly on dark skin tones.

04

Chemical Peels

Medical-grade chemical peels eliminate dead skin cells by working on the external layer of damaged skin and boost regeneration. It works wonders on treatment of pigmentation, uneven skin tone, and superficial acne scars. Many sessions are needed for effective results.

05

Subcision

Deep-rolling scars can be treated with this mild procedure known as Subcision. With the help of a fine needle, the skin is pulled downward and fibrous bands are broken. The entire procedure focuses on uplifting depressed and deep-pitted scars. Subcision is a combination of multiple treatments.

06

Dermal Fillers (For Select Cases)

For selected cases, non-permanent fillers might be used to revise deep scars and instantly boost skin softness.

Note - Book your consultation today
PERSONALISED CARE

Personalizing A Treatment Plan

Considering the unique needs of every patient, at consultation, the dermatologist

  • Examines type of skin and scar complexity
  • Analyse scar type
  • Evaluation of old treatments
  • Advise a comprehensive combination therapy

Best results are driven with the help of combination methods of treatment.

DURING TREATMENT

Skin Reactions During Treatment

01 Slight redness
02 Swelling post procedure
03 Non-permanent sensitivity
04 Slow improvement over weeks
05 Many sessions may be needed

Many treatments are less invasive and to ensure comfort they are done under topical anesthesia.

TREATMENT RESULTS

Results Of Acne Scar Treatment

The type of scar and its complexity decides the result of a procedure. Scars do not completely disappear. Effective improvement in appearance and texture is attainable. Following effective skincare and offering sun-protection can provide long-term results.

AFTER-TREATMENT

After-Treatment Care

After getting an acne scar treatment done, it is important to:

  • Stay away from direct sun exposure
  • Stick to daily prescribed sunscreen
  • Stick to a recommended skincare routine
  • Keep away from scratching skin
  • Stay regular with follow-up sessions

Proper care promises quick healing and drastic improvement.

CANDIDATE

Who Is An Ideal Candidate?

You may be the right candidate if -

  • Acne scars are evidently seen
  • Done with acne treatment
  • Are generally healthy
  • Have reasonable expectations

Even individuals with mild or darker skin tones can make the most from advanced acne scar procedures when done by medical experts.

COMBINATION THERAPY

Best Combination Therapy

It is not possible for a single treatment to improve scars at all times. Combining methods can be quite useful. Some of the effective combinations for acne scar treatment are

01 Chemical peels + laser
02 PRP + Microneedling
03 Laser + Subcision

Together these combinations offer potential results.

TREATMENT COURSE

Treatment Course & Duration

01 4 sessions for mild scars
02 6 sessions for moderate scars
03 More than 6 sessions and combination therapy for deep scars
04 All sessions are done after a gap of 4-6weeks
OUR APPROACH

Benefits Of Choosing Us For Acne Scar Treatment?

01

Specialised dermatology experts

02

Modern FDA-approved technologies

03

Tailored treatment plans

04

Safe procedures with less downtime

05

Open and honest guidance

We stress on delivering organic results while maintaining skin’s structural integrity.

YOUR JOURNEY

Begin Your Journey Towards Clearer Skin

Dealing with acne scars can be tiresome, but promising solutions are always an option. It is possible to attain smooth and bright skin by choosing the right kind of treatment.

To explore all our advanced skin and aesthetic treatments, visit Reviva Skin & Surgery .

Secure your spot today and let our experts design a tailored acne scar treatment plan to fulfill your needs. Bring back your confidence and get healthier, clearer skin with expert care you can trust.
